title: visual-explainer narration, version 2
description: The tour of the graph: an ordered list of stops. The video moves its camera to each stop and speaks its text. The page tour shows the text as a caption. render-video.mjs also checks that each focus id is a node id, a group id or "all" (render.mjs --ids lists them), appears once in its stop, and that the text has at most 9000 characters in total. A file without "version" and with "sections" is a version 1 narration (narration-v1.schema.json).

focus.description: The node ids and group ids that the stop shows. "all" shows the whole graph.

items.description: a node id, a group id or all
